category_title: Adolescents positioned as struggling readers who resist institutional labels
scenario_title: Independent book selection and reading engagement
minimal_context: Angelica is at a bookstore with her reading teacher to select books for independent reading.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We have some time in the bookstore today. Go ahead and pick out some books to read independently for class.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Great, it's another reading class. I saw all these books and I just thought this is going to be really boring.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Why don't you look at the books in this series over here?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Reads the back cover) This looks like this is not my type and I really don't care for this one. I've never really been interested in those books. They just look boring to me.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just pick out some books that you would probably like.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: You're really going to buy me some books? I'm probably not even going to read them.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: We have some time in the bookstore today. Go ahead and pick out some books to read independently for class.

STUDENT: Great, it's another reading class. I saw all these books and I just thought this is going to be really boring.

TUTOR: Why don't you look at the books in this series over here?

STUDENT: (Reads the back cover) This looks like this is not my type and I really don't care for this one. I've never really been interested in those books. They just look boring to me.

TUTOR: Just pick out some books that you would probably like.

STUDENT: You're really going to buy me some books? I'm probably not even going to read them.

task.content: Pick out some books to read independently
task.learning_goal: Recognize and claim their already existing identities as readers

context.materials: Diverse genres on a range of relevant topics, books typical of different ages, artifacts, sticky notes, poster
context.time_context: Beginning weeks of the school year

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When her Big Sister took her to a bookstore and said 'Pick out some books.'
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: I'm just like, 'You're really going to buy me some books? I'm probably not even going to read them.'
related_quotes: You're really going to buy me some books? I'm probably not even going to read them.

behavior_patterns.condition: When her mother bought her the Babysitter Club book series and said 'You better read them.'
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Concluded after reading each book's back cover that, 'This looks like this is not my type and I really don't care for this one.'
behavior_patterns.internal_state: Never really been interested in those books. They just looked boring to me.
